in_marathi.name: Navanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of New
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navanath means 'Lord of New'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'nava' meaning 'new' and 'nath' meaning 'lord'. This name is often used for a baby boy born during a new beginning or a new phase of life.
